issuers.filing_issuer: The Hartford Financial Services Group, Inc.

selection: Every issuer contributes its first originally filed 10-Q with period end 2022-09-30 and first originally filed 10-K with period end 2022-12-31. Select by EDGAR submissions metadata and filing date, before inspecting disclosure content. Main primary document only. No amendments, 8-Ks, or exhibits. Report missing forms. No substitution or deletion based on outcomes. Eight target forms, two per issuer.
score: Each economically distinct, specifically attributable USD-denominated measure in each filing is a reference unit; separately disclose directly named versus table/footnote-associated units. Score automatic amount/event with source location, then company/measure/basis/status/period. Distinguish repeats across forms from separate economic losses. Include zero-relevant forms and abstentions. Never infer allocation of joint storms, market losses or portfolio totals. The primary endpoint is frozen method vs previous frozen method on the same complete panel.
blinding: No new primary content or predictions read by the collector before this protocol. Reference reading is separated from method development. One hurricane, not a test of independent events.
